summary: Markets are still digesting last week's blowout August jobs report, which came in far above forecasts and forced traders to scale back Fed rate-cut bets in favor of a more hawkish path. That repricing keeps real yields elevated and bond volatility elevated, even as equity volatility stays subdued and crypto holds onto its recent rally.
tweet: The jobs-data shockwave keeps reshaping Fed bets, jolting bonds while stocks and crypto shrug it off for now.
